_doc: A tool account for a dressed round with a pet (spec #34, #126): Brown Kitty with every pet upgrade (as full_pet.json) and a cash item in every one of the 11 cash slots (the first cash_gallery set: hat 1002279, face 1012000, eye 1022000, earrings 1032029, top 1042000, bottom 1062003, shoes 1072010, gloves 1082040, cape 1102005, weapon cover 1702012, shield 1092031). Use it as --account=<absolute path> on playtest.sh or --run for screenshots of worn cash equipment and the pet. Test fixture only; the numbers are not tuning.
